processing: Original generated PNG bytes copied into project. Godot imports transparency and mipmaps; no bitmap edits. Painted lights and screen content are decorative.
generation_notes: Referenced-image generations of Command and Trial Hall yielded opaque checkerboards, including an attempted alpha extraction. Rejected after Godot detect_alpha=0. Fresh generations without references supplied real transparency (detect_alpha=2); original bytes copied without editing. Alpha-tested accepted artwork is used in the catalog.
